scientific limitations/integrity: This is an exact local second-variation theorem at a spherical Alexandrov--Fenchel equality ball, not a global quantitative stability inequality. The proof derives the Hessian from the published first-variation and ball-derivative formulas plus standard hypersurface variation and the exact round-sphere Laplace spectrum. A finite checker only replays coefficient identities and is not used as an infinite proof.
title: Sharp local Hessian for the full spherical Alexandrov–Fenchel family
